title: Daily Routines and Simple Present
indexDescription: Talk about habits, routines, and regular activities with confidence.
pageDescription: Describe your daily routine with the present simple
goal: Talk about daily habits using the present simple (I/you/we/they).

content.title: 1) Present Simple (I / you / we / they)
content.text: I work. You study. We live in Baku. They go to school.
content.speakText: I work. You study. We live in Baku. They go to school.

content.title: 2) Daily Routine Verbs
content.text: wake up, get up, have breakfast, go to work, come home, go to bed
content.speakText: wake up, get up, have breakfast, go to work, come home, go to bed

content.title: 3) Time Expressions
content.text: every day, in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening, at night
content.speakText: every day, in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening, at night

practice.title: Your Morning
practice.text: Say 3 things you do every morning.

practice.title: Your Evening
practice.text: Say 3 things you do in the evening.

practice.title: Every Day
practice.text: Tell a partner about your typical day in 5 short sentences.

exercise.title: Routine verbs, phrases & your day
exercise.instruction: Start practicing right away: learn routine verbs, practice sentences, then build your own.

sentence.emptyMessage: Type an action and a time.
sentence.example: Example: I wake up in the morning.

steps.title: 1. Learn routine verbs
steps.hint: Click each verb, listen, and repeat.

steps.title: 2. Practice routine sentences
steps.hint: Listen and say these present simple sentences.

items.label: I have breakfast every day.
items.translation: Mən hər gün səhər yeməyi yeyirəm.

items.label: I go to work in the morning.
items.speakText: I go to work in the morning.

items.label: They come home in the evening.
items.speakText: They come home in the evening.

items.label: I go to bed at night.
items.speakText: I go to bed at night.

steps.title: 3. Build your routine sentence
steps.hint: Type an action and a time of day.
steps.example: Example: I wake up in the morning.

sentenceOrder.title: Put the words in order
sentenceOrder.instruction: Tap the English words in the correct order.

items.prompt: Mən hər gün səhər yeməyi yeyirəm.

items.speakText: I go to work in the morning.
They come home in the evening.
I go to bed at night.

ctaDescription: Practice your daily routine aloud every day this week.

title: Present Simple with He and She
indexDescription: Use -s endings correctly with he, she, and it.
pageDescription: Talk about other people with he/she + verb-s
goal: Use the present simple correctly with he, she, and it.

content.title: 1) He / She / It + verb-s
content.text: He works. She studies. It rains a lot.
content.speakText: He works. She studies. It rains a lot.

content.title: 2) Spelling Rules
content.text: work → works, go → goes, study → studies, watch → watches
content.speakText: works, goes, studies, watches

content.title: 3) Talking About People
content.text: My brother works in a bank. My sister lives in Baku.
content.speakText: My brother works in a bank. My sister lives in Baku.

practice.title: Talk About a Friend
practice.text: Say 4 sentences about a friend using he or she.

practice.title: Jobs
practice.text: Say what people do: He works... She teaches...

practice.title: Spot the -s
practice.text: Listen for the -s ending when you practice sentences.

exercise.title: He/she forms, sentences & builder
exercise.instruction: Practice verb forms with he and she, then build your own sentence.

sentence.emptyMessage: Type a verb and an object.

steps.title: 1. Hear he/she verb forms
steps.hint: Notice the -s sound at the end of the verb.

steps.title: 2. Practice he/she sentences
steps.hint: Listen and repeat full sentences.

steps.hint: Type a present simple verb with -s and an object.

sentenceOrder.instruction: Tap the English words in the correct order.

title: Questions and Negatives with Do/Does
indexDescription: Ask questions and make negative sentences with do and does.
pageDescription: Ask and answer present simple questions
goal: Form questions and negatives with do and does.

content.title: 1) Questions
content.text: Do you work? Does she study? Do they live here?
content.speakText: Do you work? Does she study? Do they live here?

content.title: 2) Short Answers
content.text: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, she does. / No, he doesn't.
content.speakText: Yes, I do. No, I don't. Yes, she does. No, he doesn't.

content.title: 3) Negatives
content.text: I don't like coffee. He doesn't work on Sunday.
content.speakText: I don't like coffee. He doesn't work on Sunday.

practice.title: Ask 5 Questions
practice.text: Ask a partner: Do you...? Does he...?

practice.title: Short Answers Only
practice.text: Answer only with Yes, I do / No, I don't.

practice.title: Negatives
practice.text: Say 3 things you don't do every day.

exercise.title: Do/does questions, answers & builder
exercise.instruction: Practice questions and short answers, then build your own Q&A.

sentence.example: Example: Q: Do you like tea? A: Yes, I do.

steps.title: 1. Practice questions
steps.hint: Use rising intonation for yes/no questions.

steps.title: 2. Practice answers & negatives
steps.hint: Listen carefully to do / does / don't / doesn't.

steps.title: 3. Build a Q&A pair
steps.hint: Type a verb and object, then choose an answer.
steps.example: Example: Q: Do you like tea? A: Yes, I do.

sentenceOrder.instruction: Tap the English words in the correct order.

title: Can for Ability and Requests

goal: Use can to talk about ability and make simple requests.

content.title: 1) Ability

content.title: 2) Negatives

content.speakText: I can't cook. He can't drive.

content.title: 3) Requests
content.text: Can you help me? Can I open the window?
content.speakText: Can you help me? Can I open the window?
